slug: 大师姐摆烂后带五个道侣飞升了
content_zh:
【欢迎宿主来到最刺激，最内卷，最有真实体验感的修真世界！！】
系统带着几分魅惑的声音响起，虚空中它圆鼓鼓的透明体轻轻的摇摆着，看起来心情不错。
【这个世界里不仅有最逼真的修真体验，还有数不胜数的美男等你发现哦！！！】
江欲抬手打住了系统还想要说话的动作，侧眼盯着面前的认开口道：“你让我一个什么都不会的大学生去修真世界，这不是让我去送死的吗？”
“刀剑不眨眼的地方我一个脆皮大学生怎么能活下来。”
“赶紧送我回去。”
江欲觉得自己真是倒霉透了，只是躲在被窝里看小说的时候吐槽了一句这都不敢上，还不如让我来（色）。
然后她就穿越了。
穿越就算了，江欲觉得至少应该穿越到美男包围的文里吧，居然穿越到一个需要每天起床艰苦修仙，还会时不时被路过的人看不爽一剑刺死的修真界。
她不接受。
“你要是不送我回去，我等会就找个崖跳了。”
系统听到这话顿时有些慌了，立马开始找补。
【别呀宿主，您肯定是不了解这个世界的身份才不喜欢的，这个大师姐可不是普通的大师姐，她可是有五个全新未拆封的超绝道侣的。】
“哦？”江欲终于有了几分兴趣，开始正眼看着面前的系统，示意它继续说。
系统不敢耽搁，立马幻化出了五张照片。
照片上的男人各有特色。
银白长发垂落腰际，一双狭长狐眸泛着湿润水光的绝美病美人。
红发如血倾泻至腰，慵懒倚在王座上眼尾轻挑的魔族少主。
黑色长发垂落，眉眼温柔，唇边永远挂着无害微笑的邻家哥哥。
黑发高高束起，腰细挺拔的禁欲男修。

棕色头发张扬野性，宽肩窄腰的狼耳青年。
五个人出现的瞬间，江欲的眼泪瞬间就从自己的嘴角流下：“我去我去！！！”
“这么好看的男人全新未拆封？？”
“简直是暴殄天物啊！！！”
系统没管江欲后面的话，自动厚脸皮的默认为她的语气词“我去”是同意的意思，立马激动的开口。
【好嘞宿主，现在就为您开启时空通道！！！】
江欲从美色中回过神来，还没来得及矜持一下就感觉自己的脑袋有些晕，忍不住闭上了眼睛。
“江欲！你有没有听到我说话！？”
下一秒，一道怒喝声在耳边乍起，江欲被巨大的声音吓了一跳。
睁开眼睛的瞬间，一把巨长的大刀破风而来，堪堪停在了她的鼻尖一厘米的位置。
江欲被突如其来的攻击惊呆了，感慨了一句果然修真界就是不安全，反应过来立马后退了几步，捂着自己的狂跳的脆弱小心脏看向面前的人。
用刀指着她的不是别人，正是之前她在图片中看到的那个美到让男人女人都自行惭愧的红发少年。
她刚想说自己不是别人，是他的亲亲道侣，却发现面前的人神色里都是厌恶。
“你要是真的敢把我找来的玉净瓶送给她，我今天就杀了你！！！”
content_en:
[Welcome the host to the most exciting, involutional, and most realistic world of cultivation! ! 】
The system sounded with a somewhat charming voice, and its bulging transparent body swayed gently in the void, seeming to be in a good mood.
[This world not only has the most realistic cultivation experience, but also countless beauties waiting for you to discover! ! ! 】
Jiang Yu raised his hand to stop the system from trying to speak. He stared sideways at the person in front of him and said, "You asked me, a college student who knows nothing, to go to the world of cultivation. Are you not asking me to die?"
"How can I, a crispy college student, survive where the sword doesn't blink."
"Send me back quickly."
Jiang Yu felt that he was really unlucky. He just hid in bed and read a novel and complained that he didn't dare to do it, so he might as well let me do it (sex).
Then she traveled through time.
Forget about time travel, Jiang Yu felt that he should at least time travel to Wenli, surrounded by beautiful men. He actually traveled to a world of cultivation where he had to get up every day to practice hard and be stabbed to death by a sword from time to time by people passing by.
She doesn't accept it.
"If you don't send me back, I'll jump off a cliff later."
When the system heard this, it panicked and immediately started to make amends.
[Farewell, host, you must not like it because you don’t understand the identity of this world. This senior sister is not an ordinary senior sister. She has five brand new and unopened super Taoist companions. 】
"Oh?" Jiang Yu finally became somewhat interested and began to look directly at the system in front of him, gesturing for it to continue.
The system did not dare to delay and immediately transformed five photos.
The men in the photos each have their own characteristics.
She is a beautiful, sickly beauty with long silver hair hanging down around her waist and a pair of narrow fox eyes that glow with moisture.
The young demon master with red hair like blood pouring down to his waist, lazily leaning on the throne with raised eyes.
The brother next door with long black hair hanging down, gentle eyebrows and a harmless smile always on his lips.
An ascetic male cultivator with black hair tied high and a thin and straight waist.
A young man with wild brown hair and wolf ears, broad shoulders and narrow waist.
The moment the five people appeared, Jiang Yu's tears instantly flowed from the corners of his mouth: "I'm going, I'm going!!!"
"Such a good-looking man is brand new and unopened??"
“What a waste of natural resources!!!”
The system ignored Jiang Yu's words and automatically and shamelessly assumed that her modal phrase "I'm going" meant consent, and immediately spoke excitedly.
[Okay host, I will open the space-time channel for you now! ! ! 】
Jiang Yu came back to his senses from the beauty. Before he could restrain himself, he felt his head was a little dizzy and couldn't help but close his eyes.
"Jiang Yu! Did you hear me!?"
The next second, an angry shout suddenly sounded in his ears, and Jiang Yu was startled by the loud sound.
The moment she opened her eyes, a huge long knife came through the wind and stopped just one centimeter from the tip of her nose.
Jiang Yu was stunned by the sudden attack, and lamented that the world of cultivation was indeed unsafe. After reacting, he immediately took a few steps back, covering his fragile little heart that was beating wildly, and looked at the person in front of him.
The person pointing the knife at her was none other than the red-haired boy she had seen in the picture before, who was so beautiful that both men and women were ashamed.
She was about to say that she was none other than his Taoist companion, but she found that the expressions of the people in front of her were full of disgust.
"If you really dare to give her the jade purification bottle I found, I will kill you today!!!"
